title: Allocate cents by ratio
instruction: allocate(totalCents, ratios) in src/allocate.js splits an integer amount of cents into integer parts proportional to the non-negative ratios, so that the parts always add up exactly to totalCents. Use the largest-remainder method: each part starts as the proportional share rounded toward zero, and the cents still missing are given one at a time to the parts with the largest fractional remainders (ties go to the earlier index). A negative total is allocated like its absolute value with every part negated. A ratio of 0 gets 0. A total that is not an integer, an empty ratio list, a negative or non-finite ratio, or ratios that are all 0 throw a RangeError. Add regression tests.
provenanceNote: Written for pi-eval-loop holdout-v1 by the implementing agent before any optimization run; sealed (SEAL.json) and never mounted into the optimizer's sandbox.
